description: WS221 versioned legacy evidence-class mapping (read-time adaptor only; sealed artifacts are never rewritten).

mappings.legacy_term: RUNTIME_VERIFIED unless a gate cites a sealed historical frame
mappings.note: Dominant sealed claim is RUNTIME_VERIFIED; the trailing qualifier (historical-frame citation) is preserved here and must travel with any consumer of this row.

mappings.legacy_term: CODE_DERIVED for semantic comparison; TECHNICALLY_CONFORMANT for authority binding where proven; DIRECTLY_VERIFIED for git-state and validator runs; NOT_RUN for behavior
mappings.note: Per-aspect breakdown; there is no single-term mapping. Consumers must select the aspect they consume, or treat the row as UNKNOWN for behavior.

mappings.legacy_term: CODE_DERIVED unless noted as RUNTIME_VERIFIED by the named test or regression run
mappings.mapped_overrides: RUNTIME_VERIFIED only for gates the seal explicitly names as covered by a test/regression run
mappings.note: Default CODE_DERIVED; upgrade to RUNTIME_VERIFIED only where the seal names the covering run. Unnamed gates stay CODE_DERIVED.

policy: Any evidence-class term absent from both evidence-vocab-v1 and this map is INVALID_UNMAPPED and must be rejected at machine joins. This map grows only by explicit versioned amendment; never by silent default.
